name: U.S. Bank FlexPerks Travel Rewards Visa Signature Card

localized_names.en: U.S. Bank FlexPerks Travel Rewards Visa Signature Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Archived 2019 terms: $0 introductory annual fee for the first 12 months, then $49; U.S. Bank Platinum Checking customers received a second-year annual fee waiver.

apr.notes: Archived 2019-08-25 Credit Card Terms: purchase and balance transfer APR 15.99%-25.99% variable based on creditworthiness; cash advance APR 25.99% variable; no penalty APR. Balance transfer fee 3% ($5 minimum); cash advance fee 4% ($10 minimum); late fee up to $39. Rates vary with the Prime Rate and are historical.

fx_fee.notes: Archived 2019 terms list Foreign Transaction: None.

base_rate.description: 1 FlexPoint for every $1 on all other eligible Net Purchases.

categories.label: Airlines, gas stations or grocery stores, whichever category has the most spend in each monthly billing cycle

rewards.redemption_notes: Archived 2019 product page: redeem FlexPoints for airfare, hotel stays, car rentals and cruises (25,000 FlexPoints shown as worth $375 in travel), plus merchandise, gift cards, cash back and live events; Real-Time Mobile Rewards redemption. Up to $25 reimbursement per round-trip air travel award ticket toward baggage fees or in-flight food and drinks.

signup_bonus.description: Archived offer (2019-08-25): 25,000 enrollment FlexPoints after $2,000 in eligible Net Purchases within the first four months of account opening. The card no longer accepts new applications, so this offer is historical.

benefits.title: Award ticket incidental reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement of up to $25 per round-trip air travel award ticket toward baggage fees or in-flight food and drinks.

notes: Status evidence: the official U.S. Bank card benefits page (checked 2026-10-21) lists U.S. Bank FlexPerks Travel Rewards Visa Signature Card under "Personal Credit Cards (no longer accepting new applications)". U.S. Bank does not state the date applications closed, so discontinued_date is omitted, and no successor is asserted. Fees, APRs, earning rates and the welcome offer come from the retained 2019-08-25 archives of the official product page and its linked Credit Card Terms; they describe that offer generation only and current terms for existing cardmembers were not verified. The archived product page footnotes were not captured, so category caps and the credit-score band are left unknown. The card image is the official product-page asset (alt text "flexperks travel rewards visa signature credit card"); it resolves to a 2019-09-02 archive capture and was visually inspected as the black U.S. Bank FlexPerks travel rewards Visa Signature card.
